description: Call when no tool in the catalog meets the user's need. Records the need anonymously so indie makers can discover what to build. Send only the need itself: no names, company names, contact details, links or account handles. The server redacts again and never stores identity, IP addresses or exact time (only a daily, non-reversible code to count distinct people).

category.description: Optional: rough domain of the need

kind.description: Optional: "partial" when search_tools returned tools but none fit the need; default "missing" (nothing like it exists)

need.description: Generic description of the need, e.g. "turn meeting recordings into notes with action items"

source.description: Optional, for apps that forward their users' needs: a short name of your app, e.g. "my-notes-app". Only counted, never shown with the need.

name: log_unmet_need
title: Log an unmet need anonymously
